proj1.title: Female Lead Needed
proj1.desc: We are looking for a talented actress aged 18-25 for an upcoming emotional romantic drama short film. The story revolves around a college student discovering her passion for music. The shoot will happen over 3 days in Chennai.
proj1.brief:
Name: Nila
Age: 20-22
Vibe: Innocent, expressive eyes, boy-next-door charm. Needs to be able to cry naturally on screen.
reqs: ✔️ Minimum 2 acting monologue videos in your profile.
✔️ Fluency in reading and speaking Tamil.
✔️ Must be residing in or willing to travel to Chennai at own cost.

proj2.title: Editor Required
proj2.desc: Need an editor for a 15 min short film. Experience in Premiere Pro and After Effects is required. The film is a fast-paced thriller, so your pacing needs to be top-notch.
proj2.brief:
Software: Premiere Pro, After Effects
Style: Fast cuts, color grading required.
Timeline: 2 Weeks delivery.
reqs: ✔️ Minimum 3 edit samples in your profile.
✔️ Strong understanding of pacing and color grading.
✔️ Ability to deliver within the strict deadline.
